definition.en: Industry-related schemes are strategic government interventions designed to boost manufacturing, enhance competitiveness, and foster industrial growth within the Indian economy.
definition.hi: Industry-related schemes are strategic government interventions designed to boost manufacturing, enhance competitiveness, and foster industrial growth within the Indian economy.

importanceInUpsc.en: These schemes are central to the GS-3 syllabus under 'Industrial Growth' and 'Infrastructure'. Understanding these initiatives is crucial for analyzing government efforts to achieve self-reliance (Atmanirbhar Bharat) and improve the ease of doing business.
